name: Lara Lily Krželj
bio: Lara Lily Krželj was born overseas in Bosnia & Herzegovina and migrated to Australia in 2016. Has always been passionate about creating and acting, she has experience as a lead and extra in film, tv and performing a range of characters in stage work as well as creating self-directed projects. Always excited to learn more or something new. In her spare time she also enjoys writing in all forms as well as sports; she plays soccer and holds a 2nd Dan black belt in Taekwondo. Currently obtaining a Bachelor of Creative Arts (Acting) commencing June 2025 at AFTT/JMC Academy.

credits.title: Myrrh Meridian
credits.overview: On Christmas Eve, Deirdre must rescue Erik from his own false realities when he treats his ventriloquist dolls as stand-ins for the parents he’s estranged from.

credits.title: Express Yourself
credits.overview: A creative figure must reckon with others more powerful than them and forces beyond their control. Intended as a depiction of the tension between machines and man, the natural and the unnatural, especially in relation to art and sociality.
